rationale: The Evaluator feedback consistently recommends reducing steering oscillations by lowering kd and decreasing the magnitude of sensor weights, which I have done by setting kd to 0.2 and sensor_weights to [-0.7, -0.35, 0, 0.35, 0.7]. To improve line-following accuracy and progress, I increased the proportional gain kp from 8 to 12, as suggested. Base speed remains at 1.4 to balance speed and stability, and the line_loss strategy remains 'search_left' to maintain consistent recovery behavior. Geometry remains unchanged since no physical issues were indicated. I expect these changes to reduce steering oscillations further, improve line recovery, and increase progress. I request measurements including completion, progress, rms_error, line_loss_events, and steering_oscillation to verify these effects and guide further tuning.
